solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Do low B and C OK playing percussion instrument (9)

indicatorNotes.playing: letters at play move about, so they are rearranged

annotation.surface: A music teacher telling a pupil to play a low B and C, which is fine on this instrument.
annotation.walkthrough: The notes B and C look like musical instructions, but they are just letters in the mix; 'and' only joins the two halves of the fodder.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: a woodblock is a hollow wooden percussion instrument struck with a stick.

entries.clue: Observed? That’s concerning for a deplorable (8)

indicatorNotes.for: one thing standing in for another replaces it, so RE goes where the A was

blocks.note: observed = watched; its A is swapped out
re = concerning, as in a memo heading
the A of WATCHED that RE replaces

annotation.surface: Someone asks whether they were watched, and is told that is a worry for a deplorable person.
annotation.walkthrough: Write WATCHED, then put RE 'for' (in place of) its A. 'A deplorable' reads like a noun for a person; the definition is the adjective.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: wretched and deplorable both mean shockingly bad.

entries.clue: Took a picture capturing forest dweller (5)

indicatorNotes.capturing: the phrase holds the answer inside it, captured within its letters

annotation.surface: A wildlife photographer snapping a woodland animal.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a photographer capturing an animal on film, which is exactly the misdirection: 'capturing' is the hiding instruction.
annotation.definitionFit: Descriptive definition: the okapi is a giraffe relative living in the Congo rainforest.

entries.clue: Champagne celebration invoiced about wine mostly — yes (8,3)

indicatorNotes.about: BILLED goes about the wine, round it
indicatorNotes.mostly: most of the word, so ASTI loses its last letter

blocks.note: invoiced = billed, split to hold the wine
ASTI, the Italian sparkling wine, without its last letter
ay = yes, as in 'the ayes have it'

annotation.surface: A bill for a party where most of the wine went, with a cheerful yes at the end.
annotation.walkthrough: Champagne is the French region, so a Champagne celebration is a French one: 14 July, the national holiday.
annotation.definitionFit: Cryptic-leaning definition: Bastille Day is France's national day, celebrated in Champagne as everywhere else in France.

entries.clue: Gold traffic trial (6)

blocks.note: to traffic is to deal, trade illegally

annotation.surface: A court trial of someone caught smuggling gold.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Traffic' looks like cars on a road, but here it is the verb: to deal in goods.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: an ordeal is a trial, a painful experience; historically, trial by ordeal.

entries.clue: Persistent thief continued holding large Arab account (12)

indicatorNotes.holding: a word holding something has it inside, so KEPT keeps L within its letters

blocks.note: L = large, as on clothing labels
an Omani is an Arab from Oman

annotation.surface: A thief who has been running a large Arab account for a long time.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Persistent' is doing real work: a kleptomaniac steals compulsively, again and again.
annotation.definitionFit: Descriptive definition: a kleptomaniac has an urge to steal repeatedly.

entries.clue: What may control shock of one inflation measure embraced by Chinese? (7)

indicatorNotes.embraced by: HAN wraps its arms round I and RPI

blocks.note: the Han are China's main ethnic group
RPI, the Retail Prices Index, is a UK measure of inflation

annotation.surface: Asking what might tame the shock of a Chinese inflation figure.
annotation.walkthrough: A shock here is a mass of hair, not a surprise. RPI is the UK's Retail Prices Index.
annotation.definitionFit: Descriptive definition: a hairpin holds a shock (thick mass) of hair in place.

entries.clue: Where decision-maker is who it is, heat saving starts (3,4)

indicatorNotes.saving starts: saving means except: take the words except their starts, their first letters

annotation.surface: Pointing out the one who decides, whoever it happens to be, and turning down the heating.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Saving' is the old sense 'except', as in 'all saving one'. 'Who it is' reads like part of the definition, but those words are fodder.
annotation.definitionFit: Descriptive definition: the person who must make the hard decisions is said to be in the hot seat.

entries.clue: Revenue accepting PR females with one working vacancy (15)

indicatorNotes.with: 'with' means accompanied by, so HENS, I and ON come along after the revenue word

blocks.note: a machine that is working is on

annotation.surface: A revenue office taking on PR women and one more to fill a job vacancy.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Vacancy' looks like an empty post, which the surface supports; it means a vacant, uncomprehending state of mind.
annotation.definitionFit: Slightly stretched synonym: vacancy is blankness of mind, a failure to take anything in, which is incomprehension.

entries.clue: Pole on board cuts bill as one responsible for delivery (10)

indicatorNotes.cuts: MAST cuts into POSTER, splitting it

blocks.note: a bill is a poster, as in 'stick no bills'
a mast is the pole on board a ship

annotation.surface: A Polish sailor cutting his bill.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Pole' looks like a Polish person and 'bill' like an invoice; they are a ship's mast and a poster.
annotation.definitionFit: Descriptive definition: a postmaster runs a post office, responsible for delivering the mail.

entries.clue: One on entrance raised form of identification (4,3)

indicatorNotes.raised: in a down clue, raising a word turns it upwards, reading it backwards

blocks.note: a gateman is the one stationed on a gate

annotation.surface: A doorman holding up an ID badge.
annotation.walkthrough: GATEMAN read upwards is NAMETAG.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: a name tag is a badge identifying its wearer.

entries.clue: Relish used in ragu stock (5)

indicatorNotes.used in: the answer is used inside the phrase, sitting within it

annotation.surface: A cook's note on a sauce that goes into a ragù.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Relish' looks like a condiment, which fits the cooking surface; it means enthusiasm.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: gusto is hearty enjoyment, relish.

entries.clue: Exonerating badly-behaved cohort in society (10,1)

indicatorNotes.badly-behaved: letters that misbehave get out of order

annotation.surface: Letting a misbehaving group of young people off the hook.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is a grumble about a generation, and the answer is one.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: Generation X is the demographic cohort born roughly from 1965 to 1980.

entries.clue: Eg Wolverine’s half-hearted meal — bird left unfinished (9)

indicatorNotes.half-hearted: SUPPER's heart is PP; half of it goes
indicatorNotes.left unfinished: the bird is left without its final letter

blocks.note: SUPPER losing one of the two Ps at its heart

annotation.surface: A comic-book hero picking half-heartedly at a meal and abandoning the bird on the plate.
annotation.walkthrough: Wolverine is the clawed X-Men character, and 'Eg' flags him as one example of the class.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: Wolverine, of the X-Men, is a superhero.

entries.clue: In the middle of coda, composer exaggerated (7)

indicatorNotes.In: the composer goes in between the two letters
indicatorNotes.the middle of: only the central letters of coda are used

blocks.note: Giuseppe Verdi, the Italian opera composer

annotation.surface: A critic complaining that a composer laid it on too thick in the closing bars.
annotation.walkthrough: The music words coda and composer paint a concert review; coda only gives its middle letters.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: to overdo something is to exaggerate it.

entries.clue: Passed last of free parking in Dales when rambling (7)

indicatorNotes.last of: only the final letter of free
indicatorNotes.in: P is put in among the letters of Dales
indicatorNotes.when rambling: letters that ramble wander out of order

blocks.note: P = parking, as on road signs

annotation.surface: A hiker in the Yorkshire Dales who left the car in a free car park.
annotation.walkthrough: The Dales are the Yorkshire Dales, walking country in northern England, which is why 'rambling' fits the surface.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: time that has elapsed has passed.

entries.clue: Tempts people into learning a trade after first four leave (7)

indicatorNotes.after first four leave: the first four letters depart, leaving the rest

annotation.surface: Luring people into apprenticeships once the first few have quit.
annotation.walkthrough: Apprentices are people learning a trade; drop APPR and ENTICES is left.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: to entice is to tempt.

entries.clue: Vestment of some Roman soldiers (7)

blocks.note: a vestment is a garment worn by clergy at a service
a unit of a Roman legion, a couple of hundred men

annotation.surface: What Roman soldiers wore.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface asks for a uniform; the answer is two unrelated things. A maniple is a strip of cloth a priest wears on the arm at Mass, and also a company of legionaries.
annotation.definitionFit: Two senses: a priest's maniple hangs from the left arm, and a maniple was a subdivision of a legion.

entries.clue: Re concert hall item I’m confusing instrument (8,11)

indicatorNotes.confusing: letters that are confused are jumbled

annotation.surface: A letter about a concert-hall item that the writer finds puzzling, perhaps a musical instrument.
annotation.walkthrough: Concert hall primes a musical instrument; the answer is a medical one.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: a clinical thermometer is an instrument for taking body temperature.

entries.clue: Was up endlessly in bar (3)

indicatorNotes.endlessly: the word loses its end letter

blocks.note: RODE without its last letter: a jockey who rode was up on the horse

annotation.surface: Someone staying up all night in a pub.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Bar' looks like a pub, which the late-night surface encourages; it is a metal bar. In racing, the jockey 'up' is the one riding.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: a rod is a bar of metal or wood.

entries.clue: Simply a heartless fool after love, ultimately (6)

indicatorNotes.ultimately: only the final letter of love
indicatorNotes.after: A SILY comes after that E

blocks.note: SILLY with its middle L removed

annotation.surface: A plain verdict on someone: just a silly fool in the end, after a failed romance.
annotation.walkthrough: Read in answer order: the E from love, then A, then the gutted SILLY.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: done simply is done easily.

entries.clue: Spurs manoeuvring limits United (7)

indicatorNotes.manoeuvring: letters being manoeuvred are moved into a new order

blocks.note: U = United, as in football team names

annotation.surface: A football report: Tottenham Hotspur's tactics hold Manchester United in check.
annotation.walkthrough: Spurs is the nickname of Tottenham Hotspur, a London football club, and United is Manchester United, so the surface is a match report; spurs are just incentives.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: spurs are things that urge you on, stimuli.

entries.clue: Theatrical type rejected book by queen (6)

indicatorNotes.rejected: a rejected thing is thrown back, so TOME reads backwards
indicatorNotes.by: 'by' means beside, so ER is placed next to the turned book

blocks.note: a tome is a large book

annotation.surface: A dramatic sort whose book was turned down by the queen.
annotation.walkthrough: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the standard crossword queen.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: an emoter is someone who shows emotion theatrically, a ham.

entries.clue: Play unprepared and moan — what actor does on the boards? (5-4)

blocks.clueFragment: what actor does on the boards?
blocks.note: actors are said to tread the boards

annotation.surface: An actor who hasn't learnt the part, groaning his way across the stage.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Play' is musical here: to sight-read is to perform music at first sight. 'Treading the boards' means acting on stage.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: to sight-read is to play music unseen, without preparation.

entries.clue: Writer’s written up passage accommodating press (8)

indicatorNotes.written up: in a down clue, writing something upwards reverses it
indicatorNotes.accommodating: the turned passage accommodates URGE, taking it in

blocks.note: VENT, an air passage, turned upwards
to press someone is to urge them

annotation.surface: An author whose account of a passage about the press has been written up.
annotation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is': Writer is TURGENEV. Ivan Turgenev was the Russian novelist of Fathers and Sons.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: Ivan Turgenev was a 19th-century Russian writer.

entries.clue: Research facility for fast stream? (4,6)

blocks.note: a laboratory or test site, the plain half of the clue
the surface wants rushing water; the stream is of air, blown fast over models

annotation.surface: A laboratory for studying rapid rivers.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Stream' suggests water; a wind tunnel blows a fast stream of air over models to test them.
annotation.definitionFit: Cryptic definition: a wind tunnel is a research facility producing a fast airstream.

entries.clue: US city fails in delaying court attendants (6-2-7)

annotation.surface: A court case collapsing in an American city because of delays.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Court' suggests a law court, which the delays support; these are a royal court's attendants.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: ladies-in-waiting attend a queen or princess at court.

entries.clue: Scientific study of what harms crimson flower? (11)

annotation.definition: Scientific study of what harms crimson flower?

blocks.note: a science of diseases, which the surface points at plant pests
read flower as 'something that flows': the red one is blood

annotation.surface: Botanists studying a blight on red flowers.
annotation.walkthrough: Read 'flower' as 'something that flows': the crimson flower is blood, and haematology studies blood and its diseases.
annotation.definitionFit: Cryptic definition: haematology is the study of blood and the disorders that harm it.

entries.clue: Plane operators cutting pounds in the end achieves lightness (8)

indicatorNotes.cutting: the pounds are cut out of the airline word
indicatorNotes.in the end: only the last letter of achieves

blocks.note: L = pounds, from Latin libra; this is the letter removed

annotation.surface: Airlines trimming weight to save money, eventually making planes lighter.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is about fuel and luggage weight, but 'cutting pounds' means removing the letter L, the pound sign's origin.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: airiness is lightness, of weight or of manner.

entries.clue: Concedes unknown open expanses without force (6)

indicatorNotes.without: the fields go without F, losing it

blocks.note: x, y and z are the algebraic unknowns
F = force, as in physics; the letter removed

annotation.surface: Giving up unexplored open country without a fight.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Without force' sounds like surrender without violence; it tells you to drop the F from FIELDS.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: to yield is to concede.

entries.clue: What shops welcome endless import duties? (6)

indicatorNotes.endless: the word loses its final letter

blocks.note: the duties charged on imports, minus the final S

annotation.surface: Shops grumbling about the endless charges on imported goods.
annotation.walkthrough: Import duties are customs; chop the S. Custom here is trade, the patronage of customers, which every shop welcomes.
annotation.definitionFit: Descriptive definition: custom is business from customers, which shops are glad to receive.

entries.clue: American universal railway getting much interest (5)

blocks.note: U = universal, the film certificate for all ages

annotation.surface: A US railway attracting a lot of attention.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Interest' reads as attention; it means money charged on a loan.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: usury is lending at excessive interest.

entries.clue: Venetian artist National Gallery initially is giving protection (8)

indicatorNotes.initially: only the first letter of each word

blocks.note: Francesco Guardi, the 18th-century painter of Venice
National Gallery: first letters N and G

annotation.surface: A Venetian painter's work being protected at the National Gallery.
annotation.walkthrough: Guardi is less famous than Canaletto, but the National Gallery in London holds his Venetian views, so the surface is true.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: a sentry on watch shields what they watch over.

entries.clue: Pair with nine francs that is eating unknown menu offering? (4,4)

indicatorNotes.with: 'with' means together with, so the pair is followed by the rest
indicatorNotes.eating: IE eats X, taking it inside

annotation.surface: Two diners paying nine francs for something mysterious on the menu.
annotation.walkthrough: Francs and the menu point to a French restaurant, which is where the answer comes from.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: a prix fixe is a set-price menu.

entries.clue: I deliver, I am carrying uranium metal (7)

indicatorNotes.carrying: something carrying a load holds it within, so I'M has U inside it

blocks.note: to deliver someone from something is to rid them of it
U is the chemical symbol for uranium

annotation.surface: A courier admitting to carrying uranium.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Deliver' looks like a courier's job; it is the older sense, to set free, as in 'deliver us from evil'.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: iridium is a hard, dense metallic element.

entries.clue: Conservative alternative cannot live on (12)

indicatorNotes.alternative: an alternative arrangement of the letters

annotation.surface: A political complaint that the Tory alternative is finished.
annotation.walkthrough: Capital-C 'Conservative' looks like the party, and 'alternative' fits the politics; it is the plain adjective, and 'alternative' mixes the letters. The surface and the answer are opposites, conventional against alternative.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: conservative and conventional both mean sticking to accepted ways.

entries.clue: Related story with twist, which makes flight go quicker? (8)

indicatorNotes.Related: a story related is told out loud, so go by the sound

blocks.note: a tale is a story, and TAIL sounds the same
to wind is to twist, as a road winds

annotation.surface: A story with a twist ending, told to pass the time on a plane.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a gripping in-flight read; the definition means a wind blowing from behind the aircraft.
annotation.definitionFit: Descriptive definition: a tailwind blows from behind a plane and shortens the flight.

entries.clue: Thinner tears in neckwear arising, very little at first (5,6)

indicatorNotes.in: tears in a tie are inside it, so RIPS goes within TIE
indicatorNotes.arising: in a down clue, what arises reads upwards, so backwards
indicatorNotes.at first: 'at first' means at the start, so the very-little word leads the answer

blocks.note: a whit is a tiny amount, as in 'not a whit'
a tie, split to take the tears

annotation.surface: Someone slimmer whose tie is getting torn, just slightly to begin with.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Thinner' reads as slimmer; it is a paint thinner. The torn tie is turned upwards as a whole, after the tears go in, not before.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: white spirit is a solvent used as paint thinner.

entries.clue: Bottle of democrat I put in front of king (8)

indicatorNotes.put in front of: DEM and I go before the king

blocks.note: King John of England, of Magna Carta

annotation.surface: A democrat's show of nerve in standing up to a king.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Bottle' in British slang is courage, which the surface plays on; here it is a real bottle.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: a demijohn is a large narrow-necked bottle, often used in home brewing.

entries.clue: Saw what racing driver did round island (5)

indicatorNotes.round: a driver going round an island circles it, so SPED encloses I

annotation.surface: Watching a driver race round the Isle of Man circuit.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Saw' could be the tool; it is the past tense of see.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: spied means saw, caught sight of.

entries.clue: Leg joint trapped in sport so badly, the result of assault courses? (5,6)

indicatorNotes.trapped in: HOCK is caught inside the jumbled letters
indicatorNotes.badly: the letters are arranged badly, out of order

blocks.note: the hock is the ankle joint in a horse's hind leg
anagram of SPORT SO, opened to take HOCK

annotation.surface: A sports injury: a joint caught badly, the price of doing assault courses.
annotation.walkthrough: An assault course is army training, and the pun is that its product is soldiers trained for sudden assaults.
annotation.definitionFit: Cryptic definition with a question mark: shock troops are soldiers trained for assault, turned out by assault courses.

entries.clue: Unreliable to use a red-eye service? (3-2-5)

blocks.note: the adjective, as said of a dodgy business
a red-eye is an overnight flight, named for the passengers' tired eyes

annotation.surface: Why an overnight flight can't be trusted to arrive on time.
annotation.walkthrough: Take the red-eye and you literally fly by night; a fly-by-night firm is one that may vanish overnight with your money.
annotation.definitionFit: Two senses: fly-by-night means untrustworthy, and literally flying at night is taking the red-eye.

entries.clue: Author of Millions, A Life Force, Hail and Returning Evil (11)

blocks.note: chi (qi) is the life force in Chinese thought
ave = hail, as in Ave Maria
ill = evil, as in 'speak ill of'

annotation.surface: A list of book titles by one author, like a publisher's catalogue.
annotation.walkthrough: The capitals make 'Millions', 'A Life Force' and 'Hail and Returning Evil' look like titles. Machiavelli wrote The Prince, and his name means scheming evil.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by example: Niccolò Machiavelli was a Florentine author, of The Prince.

entries.clue: Confines Oscar among third-rate celebrities (9)

indicatorNotes.among: O goes among the letters of the celebrity list

blocks.note: Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet

annotation.surface: An Academy Award handed out among minor celebrities.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Oscar' looks like the film award, which suits the celebrities; it is just the letter O.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: to cloister someone is to confine them, as in a monastery.

entries.clue: Northern peninsula not entered by da Gama by India’s margins (4,6)

indicatorNotes.entered by: NOT is entered by the explorer, who goes inside it

blocks.note: taken as it stands, opened up
Vasco da Gama, the Portuguese navigator

annotation.surface: A northern peninsula da Gama never reached, having sailed by India.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is historically true: da Gama sailed round Africa to India, never to Canada. Nova Scotia is a Canadian province, almost all peninsula.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: Nova Scotia is a peninsula on Canada's Atlantic coast.

entries.clue: Lie on bed — potentially this (4-4)

indicatorNotes.potentially: the letters could potentially become this, rearranged

annotation.surface: Lounging in bed might mean you are this.
annotation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: someone lying on a bed may well be bone-idle.
annotation.definitionFit: &lit: lying about on a bed is what the bone-idle, the utterly lazy, do.

entries.clue: Means of concealing what could be king-sized failure (5,4)

blocks.note: a king-size cigarette is a smoke
a show that bombs is a failure

annotation.surface: A way of covering up a colossal flop.
annotation.walkthrough: King-size is a cigarette length, so a king-sized thing could be a smoke.
annotation.definitionFit: Descriptive definition: a smoke bomb releases a cloud to conceal movements.

entries.clue: Rake shortens changing over borders (7)

indicatorNotes.changing over borders: the two border letters change over, swapping places

blocks.note: reduces = shortens; swap its outer R and S

annotation.surface: A garden rake being trimmed down along the flower-bed edges.
annotation.walkthrough: Only the outside letters of REDUCES move: R and S change places. A rake is a womanising man, not a garden tool.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: a rake is a dissolute man, a seducer.

entries.clue: Province of Iran too corrupt (7)

indicatorNotes.corrupt: corrupted letters are spoiled out of order

annotation.surface: A complaint that an Iranian province is corrupt as well.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Province of Iran' reads as one phrase; the province is Canadian and Iran is only fodder.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: Ontario is a province of Canada.

entries.clue: Cleaning rug with a lot of beer in (6)

indicatorNotes.with: the pint goes with the wig
indicatorNotes.a lot of: most of the word, so PINT loses its last letter
indicatorNotes.in: 'in' at the end means the beer ends up inside the rug

blocks.note: a rug is slang for a wig
PINT, a beer, without its last letter

annotation.surface: Scrubbing a carpet after a lot of beer has been spilt on it.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Rug' looks like the carpet in the surface; it is slang for a toupee.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: wiping is cleaning with a cloth.

entries.clue: Group of riders race forward around ring (7)

blocks.note: to pelt is to race along

annotation.surface: Cyclists racing ahead around a track.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is the Tour de France, and so is the answer: the peloton is the main bunch of riders.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: the peloton is the main group of cyclists in a road race.

entries.clue: A stink surrounds eastern dictator putting out arms? (6)

indicatorNotes.surrounds: to surround is to encircle, so A BO wraps round the dictator

annotation.surface: An international row around an Asian dictator who is putting out weapons.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Arms' looks like weapons; it is limbs. Arms akimbo are hands on hips, elbows pointing out.
annotation.definitionFit: Descriptive definition with a question mark: arms akimbo are held out at the elbows.

entries.clue: A loud attack makes one so scared (6)

annotation.surface: A noisy assault is frightening.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface reads as one plain sentence; 'makes one so' just links the wordplay to the definition.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: afraid means scared.

entries.clue: Speak unfavourably of the underworld (3)

blocks.note: the Roman god who ruled the dead, and his realm

annotation.surface: Badmouthing gangsters.
annotation.walkthrough: 'The underworld' reads as organised crime; it is the classical land of the dead, which Dante and Virgil call Dis.
annotation.definitionFit: Two senses: dis is slang for insult, and Dis (Pluto) rules the underworld.

entries.clue: Promise variety is something represented by V (9,10)

blocks.note: a player with promise has potential

annotation.surface: A remark that a diverse promise is symbolised by a V, like a victory sign.
annotation.walkthrough: V is the physics symbol for voltage, which is potential difference.
annotation.definitionFit: Descriptive definition: potential difference, measured in volts, is written V in equations.

entries.clue: What initiates turning up in explosive (5)

indicatorNotes.turning up: in a down clue, turning up reads upwards: the IN flips to NI

blocks.note: an intro starts things off; its IN is turned

annotation.surface: Asking what sets off a device that turns up in an explosive.
annotation.walkthrough: Only the IN of INTRO is flipped, giving NI + TRO. Nitro is short for nitroglycerine.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: nitro is nitroglycerine, a powerful explosive.

entries.clue: Characters in oracle are rarely easier to discern (7)

indicatorNotes.Characters in: the answer's letters are characters sitting in the phrase

annotation.surface: The prophecies of an oracle are seldom easy to understand.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is true of the Delphic oracle, famous for riddling answers.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: clearer means easier to see or understand.

entries.clue: Note, pay attention and reflect brightly (7)

blocks.note: to listen is to pay attention

annotation.surface: Instructions to a student: take notes, listen, and think hard.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Reflect' looks like thinking, which fits the study surface; it means throwing back light.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: to glisten is to shine with reflected light.

entries.clue: Men with time in a place for the retired cut short (7)

indicatorNotes.with: 'with' means accompanied by, so the men have time alongside them
indicatorNotes.in: 'in' puts men and time inside the bed, between B and ED

blocks.note: a bed is where you go when you retire for the night
OR = other ranks, soldiers who are not officers

annotation.surface: Pensioners' time in a retirement home being cut short.
annotation.walkthrough: 'The retired' look like pensioners, but they are people who have gone to bed. OR, other ranks, is the usual crossword 'men'.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: an aborted mission is one cut short.

entries.clue: Again take tries with conversion (5)

indicatorNotes.with conversion: converted letters are changed into a new form

annotation.surface: Rugby: take the kicks again after scoring tries.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is all rugby: a try scores points and a conversion is the kick that follows. But 'conversion' is an anagram indicator, and RESIT means take an exam again.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: to resit an exam is to take it again.

entries.clue: Shape of old prisoner fitted with electronic tracker (7)

indicatorNotes.fitted with: CON is fitted with TAG, holding it inside

blocks.note: o = old, as in OE, Old English

annotation.surface: An ex-convict wearing an electronic ankle tag.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Shape of' reads as the state someone is in; it is the definition, Shape, with 'of' linking it on.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: an octagon is an eight-sided shape.

entries.clue: Poems finally got in single focus of attraction (9)

indicatorNotes.finally: only the last letter of got
indicatorNotes.in: ODES and T go inside LONE

annotation.surface: A love poem at last winning over the one person the poet adores.
annotation.walkthrough: A lodestone is naturally magnetic rock, so it is literally a focus of attraction; the figurative sense is anything that draws people.
annotation.definitionFit: Plain definition: a lodestone is a magnet, and figuratively anything that attracts.
